name: Puni Puni☆Handmaid
original_name: ぷにぷに☆はんどメイド
source:
When three magical jewels mysterious fall from the sky, Earth is suddenly thrust into inter-dimensional affairs of the gravest importance, for these stones possess the power to transform anything they come in contact into humanoid creatures with sentience and superhuman powers. Thus begins an unforgettable adventure for a seemingly ordinary student, when three normal pets he has befriended, become beautiful women who seek to win his favor and heart. Where did these stones originate? Who seeks to claim them? Why? The answers will forever change this young man’s life, and those closest to him.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175214/www.elizar.com/?p=22]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
translation:
当三颗神秘的魔力宝石从天而降，地球一夕之间被卷入了事关存亡的跨次元风波——只因这三颗奇石拥有不可思议的魔力，凡是被它们触碰到的物体，皆会化为兼具自我意识与超凡异能的人形生命体。对于一名看似平平无奇的男学生而言，一场永生难忘的奇妙冒险就此揭幕：平日与他亲近的三只普通小宠物摇身一变成了三位娇艳动人的美少女，争先恐后地想要博取他的欢心与真情。这三颗宝石究竟源自何方？暗中觊觎它们的人又是谁？背后藏着怎样的图谋？揭晓的真相，将彻底改写这名少年与他挚爱之人的命运。

[摘自Nargrakhan撰写的[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175214/www.elizar.com/?p=22]早期评测[/url]]
